description: Names, in order, of the checks every CabinetArchiveStore implementation (the in-memory fake, GRDB, plain SQLite) must pass (ArchiveStoreContract on each platform). Each platform asserts that its own contract check names equal this list, so the two contracts cannot drift.

cases.name: a new store snapshots as empty
replace swaps only part of the cabinet
snapshot includes removed and deleted boxes
replace hands the hook exactly the cabinet it replaces
a throwing hook leaves the cabinet unchanged
a box in an unknown location is rejected and changes nothing
a duplicate id is rejected and changes nothing
two default locations are rejected and changes nothing
replacing with an empty cabinet empties the store
